name: Noroxymorphone
summary: Noroxymorphone is an opioid which is both a metabolite of oxymorphone and oxycodone and is manufactured specifically as an intermediate in the production of opioid antagonists such as naltrexone and others. It is a potent agonist of the μ-opioid receptor, but is poorly able to cross the blood–brain barrier into the central nervous system, and for this reason, has only minimal analgesic activity.

pharmacology.text: Noroxymorphone is an opioid which is both a metabolite of oxymorphone and oxycodone and is manufactured specifically as an intermediate in the production of opioid antagonists such as naltrexone and others. It is a potent agonist of the μ-opioid receptor, but is poorly able to cross the blood–brain barrier into the central nervous system, and for this reason, has only minimal analgesic activity.

uses.routes: Intravenous, intramuscular, subcutaneous, oral, rectal, intranasal

uses.en: Its main use is industrial, as an intermediate in making opioid blockers such as naltrexone. It is also measured in drug testing.
uses.zh: 它的主要用途是工業上的，作為製造納曲酮等鴉片拮抗劑的中間體，也會在藥物檢驗中被測量。
uses.zhHans: 它的主要用途是工业上的，作为制造纳曲酮等鸦片拮抗剂的中间体，也会在药物检验中被测量。

sideEffects.en: It has weak opioid activity. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 它的鴉片活性較弱。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的鸦片活性较弱。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: It sits at a useful junction in opioid chemistry: the body makes it from oxycodone and oxymorphone, and factories make it on purpose as the starting point for naltrexone and naloxone.
fact.zh: 它位於鴉片化學中一個有用的交會點：人體會由羥可酮與羥嗎啡酮生成它，工廠也刻意製造它，作為合成納曲酮與納洛酮的起點。
fact.zhHans: 它位于鸦片化学中一个有用的交会点：人体会由羟可酮与羟吗啡酮生成它，工厂也刻意制造它，作为合成纳曲酮与纳洛酮的起点。
